columns.name: blockchain
columns.description: Blockchain on which this trade occurred

columns.description: Name of the dex on which the trade occurred

columns.name: version
columns.description: Version of the DEX protocol/contract

columns.name: block_month
columns.description: UTC event block month

columns.name: block_date
columns.description: UTC event block date

columns.name: block_time
columns.description: UTC event block time

columns.name: block_number
columns.description: Block number of the block in which the trade occurred

columns.name: token_bought_symbol
columns.description: Symbol of the token bought in the trade

columns.name: token_sold_symbol
columns.description: Symbol of the token sold in the trade

columns.name: token_pair
columns.description: symbol pair for the tokens involved in the trade. e.g. 'ETH/USDC'. Always alphabetical order, not trade order.

columns.name: token_bought_amount
columns.description: Amount of the token bought in the display unit

columns.name: token_sold_amount
columns.description: Amount of the token sold in the display unit

columns.name: token_bought_amount_raw
columns.description: Amount of the token bought in the base unit

columns.name: token_sold_amount_raw
columns.description: Amount of the token sold in the base unit

columns.name: amount_usd
columns.description: USD value of the trade at time of execution. Can be null if we don't have enough data to calculate the value.

columns.name: token_bought_address
columns.description: Contract address of the token bought

columns.name: token_sold_address
columns.description: Contract address of the token sold

columns.name: taker
columns.description: Address of account which purchased tokens. Can be contracts or EOA addresses.

columns.name: maker
columns.description: Address of account which sold tokens. Can be contracts or EOA addresses.

columns.name: project_contract_address
columns.description: Smart contract address which emitted the event associated with this trade. Can be the a Pool Contract, Router Contract, or other contract associated with the DEX.

columns.name: tx_hash
columns.description: The hash of the transaction that this trade was included in

columns.name: tx_from
columns.description: EOA address that sent the trade transaction, usually the trader's address, but can also be keeper bots, arbitrage bots, etc.

columns.name: tx_to
columns.description: Address that got called in the first call of this transaction

columns.name: evt_index
columns.description: Index of the event in the transaction. Can be used to uniquely identify the order of trades within in a transaction

columns.name: _updated_at
columns.description: Timestamp when this row was last written or updated by the pipeline
